prompts.title: 模拟练习 · Small steps in learning

source.label: 六级喵原创模拟练习
source.rights: 本项目自行编写，可随网站用于个人学习；非官方真题。

prompts.prompt: Write an essay on the value of making steady progress in learning. Give reasons and an example. Suggested length: 150–200 words. This is an original practice prompt.
prompts.template:
Introduce your main idea.
Explain why consistent practice helps.
Give a specific example and discuss its limits.
Conclude with a practical suggestion.
prompts.reference:
Steady progress is valuable because learning rarely happens in a single moment. A realistic routine gives students time to practise and notice what still needs attention.

For example, a student who finds listening difficult might work on one short recording each day. First, the student listens for the main idea. Next, difficult sentences are repeated and compared with the transcript. This process makes unclear sounds easier to recognise. Keeping brief notes also shows which problems occur most often. This approach also builds confidence, since learners can identify a specific improvement instead of judging themselves by a single difficult session.

However, consistency does not mean following the same plan regardless of results. If a method is ineffective, it should be adjusted. Rest is also part of a sustainable routine.

In my view, students should choose a small task they can complete, review their progress regularly, and gradually increase the challenge. Small steps become useful when they are both repeated and thoughtful.

prompts.title: 模拟练习 · 校园学习空间

source.label: 六级喵原创模拟练习
source.rights: 本项目自行编写，可随网站用于个人学习；非官方真题。

prompts.prompt:
请将下列原创段落译成英文：
近年来，许多大学不断改善校园学习环境。图书馆不仅提供书籍，也为学生提供安静的自习空间。学生可以在线预约座位，并根据自己的学习计划选择合适的时间。良好的学习环境有助于提高效率，但合理安排休息同样重要。
prompts.template:
注意时态和主谓一致。
先传达完整意思，再调整句子衔接。
避免逐字翻译中文长句。
prompts.reference: In recent years, many universities have continued to improve the learning environment on campus. Libraries provide not only books but also quiet spaces for individual study. Students can reserve seats online and choose suitable times according to their own study plans. A good learning environment helps improve efficiency, but scheduling breaks sensibly is equally important.
